name: Arizona State University
description: Arizona State University is a public research university whose largest campus is in Tempe, Arizona. It is one of the largest universities in the United States by enrolment, known for engineering, business and sustainability.
whyIncluded: Arizona State University is among the 10 universities in the United States most chosen by international students (20,368 international students in 2024-25, the most of any US public university, per IIE Open Doors), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: ASU's own budget for an international undergraduate living on campus for the academic year: housing and meals, travel, books and personal costs. Excludes tuition, fees and health insurance.
livingCosts.notes: 2026-27 international undergraduate cost of attendance: on-campus housing and meals $18,819 (combined, so all in housing, food 0); travel $1,650; books, course materials, supplies and equipment $1,320 + personal $2,343 = personal. The page does not state months; an academic year (fall + spring) is taken as 9 months.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, BSE
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international undergraduates at ASU, including the college fee for this programme, plus campus and international student fees. Rises most years; health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Fall 2026 international undergraduate table, 12+ credit hours: base international tuition $19,531 + tuition surcharge $175 + Undergraduate College Fee 5 per semester x2 ($1,095; Fee 5 covers Engineering, Business and Nursing). Other fees = Student-initiated Fee $404 + Advanced Technology Fee $100 per semester x2 (fall 2026 catalog table) + International Student Fee $400 a year (ASU international cost-of-attendance page, 2026-27). Health insurance (about $2,765 a year) excluded. ASU states tuition is subject to change and gives no guarantee to international students, so not cohort-locked. History rows carry tuition only (base + surcharge + college fee x2, from the fall 2025 and fall 2024 catalog tables); the international student fee for those years was not found, so current fees are used. 2025: College Fee 5 level; 2024: College Fee 4 level (the 2024 table had four levels). Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering, Tempe.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering, MS
programmes.summary: Yearly base tuition for international graduate students at ASU (9 credits a semester), plus campus and international student fees. Some programmes add a programme fee. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: Fall 2026 graduate table, international, 9 credit hours (full time): graduate international tuition $15,930 + tuition surcharge $175 per semester x2. Other fees = Graduate Student Support Fee $150 + Student-initiated Fee $404 + Advanced Technology Fee $100 per semester x2 + International Student Fee $400 a year (ASU international cost-of-attendance page). Health insurance excluded. ASU says some graduate programmes add differential or programme-specific tuition shown only in its online estimator (not readable here); none is included, so the true cost may be higher. History (tuition only, 9 credits x2): fall 2025 $15,174 + $175; fall 2024 $14,445 (no surcharge line). 30 credit hours; ASU's degree page gives 2 years as typical full-time completion.
